summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that the batch_size parameter does not exceed the maximum query parameters limit, similar to the logic used in bulk_update.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regression risk if there are existing use cases where users rely on the current behavior of bulk_create ignoring the max_query_params limit.
The new variable name max_batch_size could be more descriptive, such as max_query_params, to align with the existing codebase terminology.
